title: Debian Package Neglect Explorer
description: Precomputed package data for the neglect explorer scatter plot.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when UDD data was fetched.

package_count.description: Total number of packages in the array.

display_name.description: Binary or human-readable package name for display.

days_since_upload.description: Days since last upload to sid. Null if no upload history.

last_upload_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last upload. Null if none.

last_upload_version.description: Full Debian version string (epoch:upstream-revision). Null if none.

debian_upstream_version.description: Normalized upstream portion of the Debian version. Stripped of epoch, revision, +dfsg, ~debian, etc.

rc_bug_count.description: Number of open RC bugs (critical, grave, serious; open, pending, done).

oldest_rc_bug_age.description: Days since oldest open RC bug arrived. Null if no RC bugs.

vcs_status.description: vcswatch status (NEW, COMMITS, etc.). Null if not tracked.

vcs_url.description: VCS repository URL. Null if not tracked.

arch_version.description: Full Arch Linux package version. Null if not found on Arch.

arch_upstream_version.description: Normalized upstream portion of the Arch version. Null if not found.

homebrew_version.description: Full Homebrew package version. Null if not found on Homebrew.

homebrew_upstream_version.description: Normalized upstream portion of the Homebrew version. Null if not found.

freebsd_version.description: Full FreeBSD port version. Null if not found on FreeBSD.

freebsd_upstream_version.description: Normalized upstream portion of the FreeBSD version. Null if not found.

pkgsrc_version.description: Full pkgsrc package version. Null if not found on pkgsrc.

pkgsrc_upstream_version.description: Normalized upstream portion of the pkgsrc version. Null if not found.

repology_version.description: Best upstream version from Repology fast repos (nix, Void, Arch, Fedora rawhide, etc.). Null if not found.

behind_upstream.description: True if any comparison source has a newer upstream version than Debian.

version_delta.description: How far behind Debian is from the best comparison, in semver distance: major*100 + minor*10 + patch. Null if no source is newer or versions can't be compared.

best_comparison.description: Which source provided the best (largest) version delta: 'arch', 'freebsd', 'homebrew', 'pkgsrc', or 'repology'. Null if behind_upstream is false.
